apps.name: Hotels MUSE iPhone
apps.notes: Real printed MB 1987 board photo as textures (board + 8 plot tiles, no procedural painting) + serpentine track rebuilt to follow the real board: 32 spaces (START + 31 road spaces, was 28 — rule change: BUY 12 / BUILD 13 / One Free Entrance 3 / Build One Phase Free 3; stars Boomerang #3, Fujiyama #8, Le Grand #9, President #14, Waikiki #17, Royal #21, Taj Mahal #26, Safari #27). Portrait board fit (upright, centred, 10.5 x 12.8 units); dice tray moved to east felt; Bank shrank to 1.0 x 1.0 on its narrow west-edge pad. Kept from v1.5: corrected buildings (Taj 3 onion domes, Fujiyama octagonal cylinders + disc caps, Le Grand short, Safari gable, Boomerang vertical strips, Royal thick caps, Waikiki short, President 6 window rows, Bank mansard), lower camera, display-cutout safe area + BUILD sheet rewrite (48dp gold checkboxes, plain-language permit legend). v1.3 crash fix and v1.4 'Your turn' fix intact; deeds and rules unchanged except the track.
